reflections: Quinn is actively organizing a repair drive and is inviting people in a low-pressure way.

events.text: Quinn: Oh, Uli, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—come by if you can, it’d be great to see you there!

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll try to stop by if I’m able.

events.text: Quinn: Hey Kira — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive and looking for a few volunteers and tool donations. Come by if you can; it’d be great to see you there!

events.text: Quinn: Hi Opal — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive and could really use volunteers and any tool donations folks can lend. If you’re able to stop by, it’d be great to see you there!
